high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the movie "The Cold Light of Day." The poster features a dark and intense atmosphere, with a predominantly blue and black color scheme that conveys a sense of danger and urgency. Henry Cavill: Positioned prominently on the right side of the poster, he appears to be in a state of alertness or readiness, holding a gun in his right hand. His expression is serious and focused. Sigourney Weaver: She is positioned in the center-left of the poster, looking over her shoulder with a determined expression.
